Specification: This module specifies the Chang-Roberts leader election algorithm on a unidirectional ring of N nodes, where each node has a unique natural-number identity given by the sequence Id. The embedded comments explain that any subset of nodes may initiate the algorithm, and the node with the smallest identity is intended to be elected leader. The specification includes a PlusCal algorithm and its TLA+ translation, defines type correctness and a safety correctness condition about the winner and losing nodes, and states a liveness property that if some candidate exists then eventually some node wins. The temporal specification uses weak fairness for every process action and allows infinite stuttering through a Terminating action to avoid deadlock on termination.
AssumptionNames:
/\ N \in Nat \ {0}
  /\ Id \in Seq(Nat)
  /\ Len(Id) = N
  /\ \A m,n \in Node : m # n => Id[m] # Id[n]
IfThenElse:
IF initiator[self]
                  THEN /\ msgs' = [msgs EXCEPT ![succ(self)] = @ \cup {Id[self]}]
                  ELSE /\ TRUE
                       /\ msgs' = msgs

IF state[self] = "lost"
                      THEN /\ msgs' = [_msgs EXCEPT ![succ(self)] = @ \cup {id}]
                           /\ state' = state
                      ELSE /\ IF id < Id[self]
                                 THEN /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![self] = "lost"]
                                      /\ msgs' = [_msgs EXCEPT ![succ(self)] = @ \cup {id}]
                                 ELSE /\ msgs' = _msgs
                                      /\ IF id = Id[self]
                                            THEN /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![self] = "won"]
                                            ELSE /\ TRUE
                                                 /\ state' = state

IF id < Id[self]
                                 THEN /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![self] = "lost"]
                                      /\ msgs' = [_msgs EXCEPT ![succ(self)] = @ \cup {id}]
                                 ELSE /\ msgs' = _msgs
                                      /\ IF id = Id[self]
                                            THEN /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![self] = "won"]
                                            ELSE /\ TRUE
                                                 /\ state' = state

IF id = Id[self]
                                            THEN /\ state' = [state EXCEPT ![self] = "won"]
                                            ELSE /\ TRUE
                                                 /\ state' = state
